plan.summary: BRO-5268: cite trade/producer reports for recoupment outcomes on allegiance-2015, a-night-with-janis-joplin-2013, tina-2019, the-whos-tommy, leap-of-faith-2012, sweeney-todd-2023, the-notebook, on-the-town-2014
steps: Apply each commercial.json data-edit (compare-and-set on oldValue)
Each citation was read on the article page; excerpts are at most 15 quoted words

actions.oldValue: Producer statement that Allegiance lost investor money
actions.newValue: The New York Times ArtsBeat (Jan 6, 2016) reported the producers said the musical would close at a loss: "it will close at a loss to its investors" https://archive.nytimes.com/artsbeat.blogs.nytimes.com/2016/01/06/allegiance-announces-broadway-closing-date/
actions.description: allegiance-2015: NYT: closing at a loss to investors

newValue.excerpt: it will close at a loss to its investors

actions.description: allegiance-2015: NYT: closing at a loss to investors

actions.oldValue: NY Times reported 'will not recoup its investment on Broadway'
actions.newValue: The New York Times ArtsBeat (Jan 21, 2014) reported the $4.4 million production would not recoup: "production will not recoup its investment on Broadway" https://archive.nytimes.com/artsbeat.blogs.nytimes.com/2014/01/21/joplin-will-make-way-for-joneses-on-broadway/

actions.description: tina-2019: Broadway Journal: closed at a loss

actions.newValue: Broadway Journal (May 8, 2023) reported the musical closed at a loss, naming: "Tina: the Tina Turner Musical, which closed at a loss last summer" https://www.broadwayjournal.com/p/new-york-extends-3-million-broadway-tax-credit-disneys-aladdin-approved
actions.description: tina-2019: Broadway Journal: closed at a loss

newValue.excerpt: Tina: the Tina Turner Musical, which closed at a loss last summer

actions.description: tina-2019: Broadway Journal: closed at a loss

actions.newValue: The New York Times, as relayed by Rolling Stone (Jun 26, 2024), reported the revival had not recouped its capitalization when it announced its closing: "Tommy was capitalized for $15.7 million and has not recouped those funds" https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/the-who-tommy-revival-closing-on-broadway-1235046907/
actions.description: the-whos-tommy: NYT (via Rolling Stone): had not recouped at its closing announcement
leap-of-faith-2012: Playbill/NYT: producers lost the entire $14M investment

actions.oldValue: Show closed after 20 performances (April 26 - May 13, 2012), insufficient time to recoup investment
actions.newValue: Playbill (May 13, 2012) reported the musical closed at a loss: "The New York Times reported that the producers lost their entire $14 million investment." https://playbill.com/article/leap-of-faith-the-musical-pulls-down-its-broadway-tent-may-13-com-193495
actions.description: leap-of-faith-2012: Playbill/NYT: producers lost the entire $14M investment

newValue.excerpt: The New York Times reported that the producers lost their entire $14 million investment.

actions.description: leap-of-faith-2012: Playbill/NYT: producers lost the entire $14M investment
sweeney-todd-2023: BroadwayWorld: recouped its $14.5M capitalization in Nov 2023

actions.oldValue: No producer announcement. Broadway Journal (Aug 25, 2023) projected recoupment by fall 2023, about 33 weeks into the run, on a $14.5M capitalization. Counted as recouped on that projection and the run's sustained $1M+ weekly grosses.
actions.newValue: BroadwayWorld (Aug 1, 2025, by Ben Waterhouse) reported the revival recouped: "They recouped their $14.5 million capitalization in November, 2023." https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/The-Art-of-Recasting-20250801
actions.description: sweeney-todd-2023: BroadwayWorld: recouped its $14.5M capitalization in Nov 2023

newValue.excerpt: They recouped their $14.5 million capitalization in November, 2023.

actions.description: sweeney-todd-2023: BroadwayWorld: recouped its $14.5M capitalization in Nov 2023
the-notebook: lead producer Kevin McCollum (WBEZ): did not recoup on Broadway

actions.newValue: Producer Kevin McCollum said in a WBEZ interview (Aug 13, 2026) that the musical did not recoup: "McCollum said \"The Notebook\" did not recoup on Broadway" https://www.wbez.org/theater-stages/2026/08/13/broadway-chicago-musical-life-cycle-the-notebook-kevin-mccollum
actions.description: the-notebook: lead producer Kevin McCollum (WBEZ): did not recoup on Broadway
on-the-town-2014: correct a misattributed loss: the Public Theater $14M loss was its 1998 On the Town, not this 2014 revival; no loss figure reported for the revival

actions.oldValue: The Public Theater lost about $14 million on the musical 'On the Town'
actions.newValue: No loss figure has been reported for the 2014 revival. The "about $14 million" Public Theater loss Broadway Journal reported was combined across The Wild Party and the Public's 1998 On the Town, not this revival.
actions.description: on-the-town-2014: correct a misattributed loss: the Public Theater $14M loss was its 1998 On the Town, not this 2014 revival; no loss figure reported for the revival

actions.oldValue: The Public Theater lost approximately $14 million on this revival of 'On the Town'. The show ran for less than a year (October 2014 to September 2015) and was a significant financial loss for the nonprofit theater.
actions.newValue: Revival at the Lyric Theatre (Oct 2014 to Sep 2015), with a projected $8.5 million capitalization raised partly online (Variety, Aug 13, 2014). Closed without a recoupment announcement; no loss figure reported.
actions.description: on-the-town-2014: correct a misattributed loss: the Public Theater $14M loss was its 1998 On the Town, not this 2014 revival; no loss figure reported for the revival

newValue.excerpt: projected $8.5 million capitalization for "On the Town"

actions.description: on-the-town-2014: correct a misattributed loss: the Public Theater $14M loss was its 1998 On the Town, not this 2014 revival; no loss figure reported for the revival
